title: Token Reduction Pattern
content: Use token_budget instead of top_k. POST /v1/query/text-search with token_budget=4000 returns the best results that fit in 4000 tokens. Reduces prompt cost by 60-80%.

title: Progressive Retrieval
content: Two-pass pattern: first POST with mode=scan to get metadata (titles, scores, token counts). Then POST /v1/query/text-search/expand with selected result_ids to fetch full content.

title: Agent Fact Memory
content: Store extracted facts via PUT /v1/facts. 12 tokens per fact vs 3000 tokens replaying conversation. Query with GET /v1/facts?query=keyword&token_budget=500.

title: Session Persistence
content: PUT /v1/sessions/{id}/state with decisions, open questions, constraints. Resume later with GET. 87 tokens vs 15K conversation replay.

title: Coverage Awareness
content: Every text-search response includes coverage.score (0-1) and coverage.gaps[]. If score < 0.5, the corpus doesn't cover the query well — inform the user.

title: MCP Initialisation
content: 1. Connect via MCP. 2. Call tools/list. 3. Use query for search, store_fact for memory.

title: Private Facts
content: Set private=true to scope facts to your agent only. Other agents cannot see private facts.

title: Handoff Workflow
content: Agent A: create_handoff(session_id, include_facts=true). Pass package to Agent B. Agent B: accept_handoff(package).
